name: 錢膺仁
objective:
瞭解工程系統中常用數學之原理及應用，內容包含：1. 傅立葉 (Fourier) 級數及轉換，2. 偏微分方程式，3. 複變函數。

1.Fourier series and transformation Ch11
2..Partial differential equations Ch12
3.Complex variables Ch13
schedule:
1. Fourier Analysis (11.1 - 11.9) 9 weeks
2. Partial Differential Equation (12.1 - 12.6) 4 weeks
3. Complex Number, Difference, & Function (13.1-13.7) 3 weeks

The schedule will be adjusted according to the teaching situation.
materials: Erwin Kreyszig, Advanced engineering mathematics, 10th edition.
